name: fem submodel: an 80 × 40 × 10 steel plate with a 12 mm hole
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.actions.closeProject({ force: true }); await m.actions.newDocument('part', { blank: true }); await sleep(300); const { itemsToSketch } = await import('/src/cad/cad2d-import.js'); const { createFeature } = await import('/src/cad/features.js'); m.actions.change('op.feature', (p) => { const part = p.parts.find((x) => x.id === p.active.id); const { sketch } = itemsToSketch([{ kind: 'line', a: [0, 0], b: [80, 0] }, { kind: 'line', a: [80, 0], b: [80, 40] }, { kind: 'line', a: [80, 40], b: [0, 40] }, { kind: 'line', a: [0, 40], b: [0, 0] }, { kind: 'circle', c: [20, 20], r: 6 }]); const sk = createFeature(part, 'sketch', { plane: { kind: 'std', name: 'top' }, ...sketch }); part.features.push(sk, createFeature(part, 'extrude', { sketch: sk.id, depth: 10 })); }); await sleep(1200); await m.run('simulation'); await sleep(300); return JSON.stringify({ mode: m.state.editing?.mode, cyl: m.state.partEntry.faces.filter((f) => /CYL/.test(f.geomType)).length }); })()

name: fem submodel: a coarse plate pulled from the end; a 16 mm cube at the hole solved finer finds a higher peak, its cuts match the global stress, coloured on the model
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const faces = m.state.partEntry.faces; const all = faces.map((f, index) => ({ f, index })); const mk = (x, kind) => ({ index: x.index, faceId: x.f.hashCode, type: x.f.geomType, ...(kind ? { kind } : {}) }); const planes = all.filter((x) => x.f.geomType === 'PLANE'); const at = (c, v) => planes.find((x) => Math.abs(x.f.center[c] - v) < 1e-6); const run = async () => { await m.actions.pmCommand('runSim'); for (let i = 0; i < 800 && !m.state.editing.result; i++) await sleep(150); return m.state.editing.result; }; const e = m.state.editing; const none = Boolean(document.querySelector('[data-pm-command="fem.submodel"], [data-command="fem.submodel"]')); e.loadKind = 'force'; e.dir = 'x'; e.magnitude = 20000; e.elementSize = 8; e.fixtures = [mk(at('x', 0), 'fixed')]; e.loads = [mk(at('x', 80))]; e.result = null; const g = await run(); await sleep(200); const group = Boolean(document.querySelector('[data-pm-field="subSize"]')); e.probes = [{ point: [20, 13, 5] }]; m.actions.pmFieldChanged('subSize', '16'); m.actions.pmFieldChanged('subElement', '1.2'); await sleep(100); await m.actions.pmCommand('fem.submodel'); for (let i = 0; i < 600 && !e.sub; i++) await sleep(150); await sleep(300); const s = e.sub; const shown = Boolean(document.querySelector('.fem-sub-results')); return JSON.stringify({ ok: g?.ok, group, sub: Boolean(s), cuts: s?.cutFaces, higher: s && s.maxStress > s.globalRegionMax, match: s && Math.abs(s.boundary - 1) < 0.15, preview: Boolean(e.subPreview?.colors?.length), shown, v: s && [+(s.maxStress).toFixed(1), +(s.globalRegionMax).toFixed(1), +(s.boundary).toFixed(3), s.elements] }); })()

name: fem submodel: the submodel's stress on the model and its results in the PropertyManager
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.run('isometric'); await m.run('zoomFit'); await sleep(900); document.querySelector('.fem-sub-results')?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); await sleep(200); return /예기치 않은 오류|Unexpected error/.test(document.body.innerText) ? 'crashed' : 'ok'; })()

name: fem submodel: a new run of the whole part clears the submodel
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const faces = m.state.partEntry.faces; const all = faces.map((f, index) => ({ f, index })); const mk = (x, kind) => ({ index: x.index, faceId: x.f.hashCode, type: x.f.geomType, ...(kind ? { kind } : {}) }); const planes = all.filter((x) => x.f.geomType === 'PLANE'); const at = (c, v) => planes.find((x) => Math.abs(x.f.center[c] - v) < 1e-6); const run = async () => { await m.actions.pmCommand('runSim'); for (let i = 0; i < 800 && !m.state.editing.result; i++) await sleep(150); return m.state.editing.result; }; const e = m.state.editing; e.result = null; await run(); return JSON.stringify({ sub: e.sub, preview: e.subPreview }); })()
